news.title: Medal of Honor recipient Dakota Meyer visits NAS Pensacola
news.summary: Trained with aircrew candidates and toured housing; base stressed service-member well-being.

news.title: Homecoming Air Show draws large crowds for NAS Pensacola's 200th
news.summary: The Nov. 6–7 show closed the Blue Angels' 80th season; the base cited 150,000+ visitors, local TV estimated 300,000+.

news.title: Blue Angels fly finale with five jets after No. 6 pilot removed
news.summary: The Navy dismissed a Marine pilot and a public affairs officer before the season finale; no specifics given.

news.title: Blue Angels wrap 2026 show season at home
news.summary: Season closer at NAS Pensacola; the 2027 Homecoming is scheduled for Nov. 5–6.

news.title: C-2A Greyhound retires with final landing at NAS Pensacola
news.summary: The carrier-delivery aircraft ended six decades of service; one joins the naval aviation museum.

base.note: Base map from OpenStreetMap; points of interest from OpenStreetMap and official NAS Pensacola / CNIC information. Spots marked 'approx.' are placed from their published street address, not an exact building outline.

poi.name: Main Gate & Visitor Control Center (Bldg 777)
poi.note: South end of Navy Boulevard. Open 24/7 for DoD ID holders; visitors without a DoD ID check in at the VCC here. Barrancas National Cemetery visitors enter here.

poi.name: West Gate (Blue Angel Parkway)
poi.note: South end of Blue Angel Parkway. The public entrance for the National Naval Aviation Museum and Pensacola Lighthouse, open to visitors 9 a.m. – 3 p.m.

poi.name: Corry Station gate
poi.note: Entrance to Corry Station off Navy Boulevard / New Warrington Road. Corry has the main Navy Exchange, the commissary and the information-warfare schoolhouses.

poi.name: Forrest Sherman Field
poi.note: NAS Pensacola's airfield: runways 07L/25R, 07R/25L and 01/19. Home of the Blue Angels, who practice here in season.

poi.name: Air terminal
poi.note: Air operations terminal on the Sherman Field flight line.

poi.name: Jet Port Café — base galley (Bldg 3900)
poi.note: The main enlisted dining facility, at the NATTC complex (2 Taylor Road). Breakfast, lunch and dinner daily; cashless.

poi.name: NATTC food court (Subway, Panda Express, Starbucks)
poi.note: Fast-food outlets next to the NEX store at the NATTC complex.

poi.name: Mustin Beach Officers' Club
poi.note: Club and restaurant on the waterfront.

poi.name: Green Beans Coffee
poi.note: Coffee shop on the main side.

poi.name: NATTC barracks (unaccompanied housing, incl. Barracks E Bldg 3910)
poi.note: The main enlisted barracks complex at 905 East Avenue. NAS Pensacola's unaccompanied housing holds about 4,500 people in 14 buildings; the check-in/billeting office is in Barracks E, Bldg 3910.

poi.name: BOQ Road quarters (Bldg 3249)
poi.note: Unaccompanied housing on BOQ Road.

poi.name: Corry Station barracks (Bldg 1084)
poi.note: Student barracks at Corry Station, 640 Roberts Avenue. Marine entry-level students are housed here.

poi.name: Navy Exchange (NEX) main store
poi.note: The main Navy Exchange department store, at Corry Station.

poi.name: Commissary
poi.note: Defense Commissary Agency grocery store, at Corry Station next to the NEX.

poi.name: NEX Package Store & MWR Tickets
poi.note: At Corry Station.

poi.name: NEX gas station (Corry)
poi.note: At Corry Station.

poi.name: NEX store & Uniform Shop (NATTC)
poi.note: Smaller NEX and the uniform store on the main side.

poi.name: NEX Sherman gas station
poi.note: Gas station near Sherman Field.

poi.name: Post office
poi.note: USPS branch on the main side.

poi.name: Radford Gym
poi.note: Fitness center.

poi.name: MWR Liberty Center (Bldg 3912)
poi.note: Recreation center for junior enlisted, next to the NATTC barracks.

poi.name: Bayou Grande Marina
poi.note: MWR marina.

poi.name: Building 633 — Naval Aviation Schools Command
poi.note: Historic schoolhouse where generations of naval aviators have trained since 1941.

poi.name: Naval Hospital Pensacola
poi.note: Next to Corry Station.

poi.name: National Naval Aviation Museum
poi.note: Free museum, open to the public via the West Gate.

poi.name: Pensacola Lighthouse
poi.note: 1859 lighthouse and museum, open to the public.

poi.name: Fort Barrancas
poi.note: Civil War–era fort, part of Gulf Islands National Seashore.

poi.name: Coast Guard cutters
poi.note: Homeport pier for cutters including Dauntless, Decisive and Reliance.
